nodes.summary:
usage: corvint-release-candidate --core-dir DIR --source-root DIR --scratch DIR --output-parent DIR --version VERSION [--companion-dir DIR]
--companion-dir: verified companion retained directory (omit for a Core-only candidate)
--core-dir: verified core archive-gate directory
--output-parent: parent for the fresh versioned candidate
--scratch: private scratch directory
--source-root: Corvint Git checkout containing the exact built commit
--version: exact release version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-rc.N or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCHaN, without a v prefix
usage: corvint-release-candidate --core-dir DIR --source-root DIR --scratch DIR --output-parent DIR --version VERSION [--companion-dir DIR]
nodes.example: corvint-release-candidate --core-dir DIR --source-root DIR --scratch DIR --output-parent DIR --version VERSION
